evidence_frontier: The latest completed w8 confirmation (PNN-v1-W8-Confirmation) trained Alpha5 w8 for 50 epochs on ECG200 and achieved 424/500 correct versus the Alpha5 w16 control 441/500, failing the relative gate (candidate_correct >= control_correct -10). Earlier experiments (Exp021) showed w8 at 887/1000 correct after longer training (100 epochs) but on a different split, and the w12 variant also underperformed. The boundary for local_width=8 remains unconfirmed for the standard 100‑epoch training regime.
analysis: Observations: (1) At 50 epochs, w8 underperforms w16 by 17 correct predictions on 500 samples. (2) The same architecture trained for 100 epochs in Exp021 reached 887/1000 correct, suggesting longer training improves w8 performance. (3) No prior experiment has tested w8 versus w16 with exactly 100 epochs on the ECG200 train/test split using the preregistered seed set [42,43,44,45,46]. This gap constitutes the current evidence frontier.
hypothesis: Extending training of Alpha5 with local_width=8 to 100 epochs will close the performance gap to within 10 correct predictions of the concurrent Alpha5 w16 control on ECG200, satisfying the relative aggregate gate.

proposal.title: Confirmation of w8 Local‑Width Boundary with Extended Training
proposal.research_question: Does training Alpha5 with local_width=8 for 100 epochs achieve performance within 10 correct predictions of the Alpha5 w16 control on ECG200?
proposal.rationale: The 50‑epoch w8 confirmation failed the gate, but longer training in prior work suggests the gap may shrink. Confirming the w8 boundary under the original training budget is essential before considering further architectural reductions.

procedure: For each seed, train Alpha5 with local_width=8 for exactly 100 epochs on the ECG200 TRAIN split (100 samples).
Simultaneously, train the concurrent Alpha5 control with local_width=16 for exactly 100 epochs on the same TRAIN split and seeds.
After training, evaluate both models on the ECG200 TEST split (100 samples) per seed, yielding 5 × 100 = 500 predictions per model.
Aggregate the number of correct Q.ANT predictions for each model across all seeds.

proposal.success_criteria: candidate_correct >= control_correct - 10 on 500 predictions (5 seeds × 100 test samples).
proposal.risks: If 100 epochs are insufficient, the w8 model may still fall short of the gate, leading to inconclusive results. Simulation variance across seeds could obscure true performance differences. The experiment consumes the full allocated epoch budget, limiting exploration of alternative training schedules.
